She tested on the smallest details and there was so much to know, on top of other finals that it was impossible to memorize.  I hope she curves well since the final was worth a lot

Professor Huffaker is awesome! I love her! She's one of the sweetest professors I've seen at UCSD. She's so kind and so helpful. With that in mind, BIBC100 is not an easy class. There's a lot of details you have to know. So make sure you read. She gives clicker questions, so you must attend. I highly, highly recommend taking her  :)

Structural requires tons of memorizations and is very lecture heavy. However, Dr. Huffaker tries her best to help us for a good grade. Weekly problem set (full credits earned if you copy mostly from her slides), one midterm (can be replaced if final is better), one final. Her slides are all you need to know. She is super sweet! Extra credits given!

The way Professor Huffaker structures her class is very straightforward. The material itself is very dense, so it requires a lot of memorization and practice. She has weekly problem sets because of that which emphasizes what she expects you to know from the many many slides (you won't need the textbook for her class). She also gives extra credit!
